name: SVG Editor
description: Implement WON-887 https://linear.app/wonop/issue/WON-887/svg-editor-native-viewing-and-source-editing-inside-wonop. Briefly research sensible existing foundations for a simple native Wonop SVG editor, choose pragmatic lightweight approach, then implement without another planning approval. Safe SVG viewing, SVG source editing with live preview, opening/saving SVG files, useful for architecture diagrams. Keep uncomplicated; not full vector illustration suite. Follow package development conventions and test. May read/copy /private/tmp/wonopstudio-pagesprinter-migration/memory-architecture.svg as test input without modifying original. Do not disturb existing agents. Excalidraw research separate. No publishing or pushing.
